boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 95 packs colored blocks (red, orange, blue, green, purple, cyan) with lock/key gates into a horizontal upper tier, while two purple chambers fill the lower section — counter `14` in an orange frame on top, counter `11` in an orange frame below. Yellow accent blocks on the edges are free single-piece clears. Empty the upper tier completely, then feed both chambers for 25 total passes.
landmarks: Block Out Level 95 packs colored blocks (red, orange, blue, green, purple, cyan) with lock/key gates into a horizontal upper tier, while two purple chambers fill the lower section — counter `14` in an orange frame on top, counter `11` in an orange frame below.
Yellow accent blocks on the edges are free single-piece clears.
Empty the upper tier completely, then feed both chambers for 25 total passes.

quickTips: Take the yellow edge blocks first — they are free single-piece clears right next to exits.
Clear the small blocks between tiers before starting the `14` chamber feed.
Feed the `14` chamber before the `11` — it needs more room and more passes.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Push the yellow edge blocks on both sides through the left and right exits for immediate room (01:26 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the key block (small cyan with key icon) to unlock the orange block in the upper tier (01:22).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Extract the large red blocks from the center-left through the top or left exit because they are the biggest mass in the upper tier (01:18).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the green and blue blocks from the right side of the upper tier through the right-wall exit (01:15).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Remove the small cyan and red blocks between the upper tier and the `14` chamber before starting the feed because they can drift into the lane (01:11).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Begin feeding the upper purple chamber (counter `14`) — keep its lane permanently clear for fourteen passes (01:07–00:56).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Feed the lower purple chamber (counter `11`) through the bottom exits — eleven passes to finish (00:53–00:45).

failurePoints: Ignoring the yellow edge blocks at the start — they are free room and clearing them first makes every subsequent extraction faster.
Starting the `14` chamber feed while small cyan and red blocks between tiers are still present — they drift into the feed lane and stall the counter.
